The checker rejected the word "input", which appeared in comments and is not a real I/O call. I removed that word, cleaned up a leftover expression, and kept the five-transistor OTA topology unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),       # diff-pair L
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.4, 0.15, 1.5),       # PMOS mirror L
    "gmidt": (11.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),       # tail L
    "fu":    (62e6, 45e6, 120e6),    # design target UGBW
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8

    # required pair gm -> branch current
    gm1 = 2 * PI * p["fu"] * cl
    I1 = gm1 / p["gmid1"]
    Itail = 2 * I1

    # iterate tail node voltage (body effect on the pair)
    vtail = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(0.08, vcm - m1.vgs)

    # PMOS mirror load (diode: vds = vgs)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.7)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    vout_dc = vdd - m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(0.2, vout_dc - vtail), vsb=vtail)

    # tail and reference (same L, same gm/Id, scaled current)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=max(0.1, vtail))
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the mirror-diode side, so vout (M2 drain) is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # predictions
    gm = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm / gout
    ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # mirror pole-zero doublet (zero at 2*fp2) softens phase loss
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    sr = Itail / ctot
    vstep = 0.5
    tslew = max(0.0, vstep - 2 * I1 / gm) / sr
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = tslew + tau * math.log(100) * 1.15

    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "settle": settle, "slew": sr, "power": vdd * (Itail + iref)}
```
